outcome: left ventricular regional wall movement abnormalities
borderline reduction of left ventricular ejection fraction
cohort: A 42-year-old patient who underwent a Caesarean section at 33 weeks of pregnancy and subsequently tested positive for COVID-19.
finding: A 42-year-old woman developed midventricular stress cardiomyopathy following a Caesarean section and SARS-CoV-2 infection.
mod_finding: The patient developed midventricular stress cardiomyopathy after undergoing a Caesarean section.
